SCALE_PULSES.listing:
scale_pulses:
  mul w0, w0, w1 C4
  ret C4

QUOTIENT_UNSIGNED.listing:
quotient_unsigned:
  udiv w0, w0, w1 C4
  ret C4

QUOTIENT_SIGNED.listing:
quotient_signed:
  sdiv w0, w0, w1 C4
  ret C4

SCALED_TOTAL.listing:
scaled_total:
  madd w0, w0, w1, w2 C4
  ret C4

REMAINDER_SIGNED.listing:
remainder_signed:
  sdiv w2, w0, w1 C3
  msub w0, w2, w1, w0 C4
  ret C4

WIDE_SIGNED.listing:
wide_signed:
  smull x0, w1, w0 C4
  ret C4

WIDE_UNSIGNED.listing:
wide_unsigned:
  umull x0, w1, w0 C4
  ret C4

GROUPS_OF_TEN.listing:
groups_of_ten:
  mov w1, 52429 C3
  movk w1, 0xcccc, lsl 16 C3
  umull x0, w0, w1 C3
  lsr x0, x0, 35 C4
  ret C4

PRODUCT_HALVES.listing:
product_halves:
  mul x2, x0, x1
  umulh x3, x0, x1
  smulh x4, x0, x1
  ret

WIDE_TOO_LATE.listing:
wide_too_late:
  mul w0, w0, w1
  ret

SUBTRACT_PRODUCT.listing:
subtract_product:
  msub w0, w1, w2, w0
  ret

WRONG_REMAINDER.listing:
wrong_remainder:
  udiv w2, w0, w1
  msub w0, w2, w1, w0
  ret

DIVIDE_EDGES.listing:
divide_edges:
  sdiv w2, w0, w1
  udiv w3, w0, w1
  ret

CONSUMPTION.listing:
consumption:
  cbz w1, zero
  mov w2, #100
  umull x0, w0, w2
  mov w1, w1
  udiv x0, x0, x1
  ret
zero:
  mov x0, #0
  ret
